name: Kinwoo
description: A shared-home app for housemates to manage shared lists, expenses, bills, and tasks in one place. Everything shared. Nothing forgotten.
about: Kinwoo helps the people in a shared home keep track of what the home needs. You create or join a house, then work with your housemates on shared lists, expenses, bills, and tasks.
Everything that happens in a house shows up in an activity feed, so it's always clear who bought what, who paid whom, and what's still pending.
It runs as an installable web app (PWA) with offline support and push notifications, backed by a mobile app for Android.
features: Create a house and invite housemates with a link or a 6-character code
Shared lists and items, with private lists visible only to their owner
Shared expenses with balances, settle-up, and recorded payments
Bills and tasks for everything the house needs to get done
Activity feed and notifications for every change in the house
Admin and member roles, with member removal and leaving a house
Email OTP and Google sign-in, with profile avatars
Installable PWA with offline support and push notifications
Row-level security in the database, so only housemates can see house data
In-app feedback delivered to Telegram
Multi-environment CI/CD with test and production deployments

name: Word Lock
description: A real-time 2-player word territory game where players take turns spelling words on a shared 5×5 letter grid - claiming tiles, flipping opponents' letters, and racing to dominate the board.
about: Word Lock is a real-time 2-player word territory game where players compete on a shared 5×5 letter grid. Take turns spelling words to claim tiles, flip your opponent's letters, and dominate the board.
Every tile you use in a valid word becomes yours. Tiles your opponent owned flip to your colour. A tile surrounded on all sides by your own tiles is locked - your opponent can no longer steal it.
The game ends when every tile is claimed. Whoever owns the most tiles wins. Turns expire after 24 hours, keeping the game moving.
features: Real-time 2-player word territory gameplay
Shared 5×5 letter grid with tile claiming mechanics
Flip opponent's tiles by spelling words through them
Lock tiles by surrounding them with your own
Turn-based gameplay with 24-hour turn expiration
Live game state synced via Supabase Realtime
Word validation with minimum 3-letter requirement
Winner determined by most tiles owned when board is full

name: Bole Capital
description: A website for an AMFI-registered mutual fund distributor in Dhanbad, with investor tools, educational resources, and lead capture delivered to Telegram in real time.
about: Bole Capital is the website for an AMFI-registered mutual fund distributor based in Dhanbad, built to explain services clearly and make it easy for investors to get in touch.
It covers mutual funds, portfolio reviews, goal-based investing, PMS, SIF, and insurance, alongside a SIP calculator, goal planner, FAQ, and glossary to help visitors make sense of investing.
Enquiries from the portfolio review and contact forms are validated, rate-limited, and forwarded straight to Telegram. No submissions are stored, and regulatory disclosures are kept in one place.
features: Service pages for mutual funds, portfolio review, goal-based investing, PMS, SIF, and insurance
SIP calculator and goal planner with downloadable PDF reports
FAQ and investor glossary
Portfolio review and contact forms delivered to Telegram in real time
Origin checks, per-IP rate limiting, and honeypot spam protection on forms
No database, form submissions are never stored
Centralised regulatory disclosures, policy pages, and investor links
SEO-friendly structure with JSON-LD, sitemap, and security headers
Statically prerendered pages with multi-environment CI/CD

name: We Track
description: A self-hosted learning platform for tracking progress across locally stored video courses.
about: We Track helps learners organize and track progress across video-based courses stored on their local machine.
The application automatically scans course folders, reads video metadata, and stores progress, notes, and tags in a local SQLite database.
Designed with privacy in mind, everything runs offline with no cloud services or accounts required.
features: Automatic course folder scanning
Video progress tracking
Resume from last watched video
Video-specific notes
Course tagging and organization
Automatic cleanup of missing files
Offline-first experience
Docker support

name: e4
description: A tiny, no-fuss chess board that thinks right alongside you. You play your side, it whispers a strong move whenever you want one.
about: A tiny, no-fuss chess board that thinks right alongside you. It's your personal coach. You play your side, it whispers a strong move whenever you want one - all in your browser, no sign-ups, no nonsense.
Named after chess's most famous opening move. (Yes, the pun is on purpose.)
The 'brain' is Stockfish, one of the strongest chess engines on the planet, shrunk down to run on a web page.
features: Hints for your side, a little arrow points you toward a strong move whenever you're stuck
Follow any game, enter your opponent's moves yourself and keep getting nudges for your replies
A real engine in your pocket, Stockfish runs right inside your browser
Five difficulty levels, from "gentle nudge" to "okay, it's actually good now"
Rewind anytime, step back and forth through every move you've played
Themes & dark mode, make it feel like yours
Satisfying click-clacks, sounds for moves, captures, and checks
Phone or laptop, it just fits

name: Kriva Pictures
description: A photography business website showcasing visual stories, galleries, and creative work.
about: Kriva Pictures is a professional photography website built to showcase portfolios, galleries, and visual storytelling.
The platform provides a modern and responsive browsing experience across desktop and mobile devices.
It is optimized for fast image delivery and streamlined content management using Cloudinary.
features: Photography portfolio showcase
Responsive gallery experience
Cloudinary-powered image management
SEO-friendly architecture
Multi-environment deployment workflow
Automated CI/CD pipelines
Optimized image delivery

name: Chain
description: A real-time 2-player word dueling game where players pick letters, form word chains, and race against a timer.
about: Chain Letters is a real-time 2-player word dueling game. Each round, both players secretly pick a letter - one becomes the Start letter, the other the End letter.
Players then take turns submitting words that must begin with the Start letter and end with the End letter, building a chain under the pressure of a countdown timer.
Run out of time, submit an invalid word, and your opponent wins the round. Win the most rounds to take the match - best of 1, 3, or 5, host's choice.
features: Real-time 2-player duels over a shared room code
Secret letter picking, one player's letter becomes Start, the other's becomes End
Word chain validation on every submission
Per-turn countdown timer, run out and your opponent wins the round
Best-of-1, 3, or 5 match format, set by the host
Live game state synced via Supabase Realtime

name: Q Pilot
description: An AI-powered question generator that creates interview questions from any topic or technology.
about: QPilot helps developers, interviewers, educators, and learners generate high-quality questions on demand.
Users can provide a technology or concepts and instantly receive tailored questions with varying difficulty levels.
Built to streamline interview preparation, QPilot removes the manual effort of researching and writing questions.
features: AI-powered question generation
Generate questions from topics
Multiple difficulty levels
Favorites and organize questions
Dark and light theme support
